step_1_castable_slot_count.claim: Syndra has exactly four castable abilities: Q Dark Sphere, W Force of Will, E Scatter the Weak, R Unleashed Power. P Transcendent is a passive stat/stack system, not a cast.
step_1_castable_slot_count.source: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities keys P,Q,W,E,R; P Transcendent is 'Innate:' with targeting 'Passive', affects 'Self', and its only stat effect is 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.'
step_1_castable_slot_count.consequence: A one-rotation derived cast order over Syndra's castable slots is a 4-element list -> valid indices 0..3. Index 4 must not exist.

candidate_A_second_Dark_Sphere_charge.text: Q 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' (data/champions.json, Syndra Q, effect 2)
candidate_A_second_Dark_Sphere_charge.assessment: A second Q cast exists only in an opt-in stack state (>=40 Splinters; the audit records it as the synthetic 'Q2' slot gated on a splinters option, data/champion-audit/batch-6.json: 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge'). Even where it applies, it produces a repeated Q, never a second R.

candidate_B_R_recast_in_a_timed_window.cooldowns: R base cooldown 120/100/80 s, affectedByCdr true (data/champions.json Syndra R). Ability haste identity cd' = cd*100/(100+AH) (CLAUDE.md domain rule; docs/math-foundations.md sec.5 row 'Ability haste (effective_cooldown)').
candidate_B_R_recast_in_a_timed_window.arithmetic: Even at an extreme 100 AH: 80*100/200 = 40.0 s (rank 3), 100*100/200 = 50.0 s, 120*100/200 = 60.0 s -- far longer than any corpus fight window.
candidate_B_R_recast_in_a_timed_window.documented_constraint: docs/math-foundations.md sec.5: 'R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)' and, on the rotation row, 'R single-cast'; the audit conclusion repeats 'R single-cast' as one of the documented approximations.
candidate_B_R_recast_in_a_timed_window.verdict_for_this_leaf: R can appear at most once, so index 4 cannot be a second R

candidate_C_R_as_the_single_cast_schedul.scheduler: docs/math-foundations.md sec.1.1: 'Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts)' -- 'the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.'
candidate_C_R_as_the_single_cast_schedul.arithmetic: For R to sit at index 4, four casts must start before it. Syndra's cast times are Q 'none', W 'none', E 0.25 s, R 0.25 s, so the first three casts occupy well under ~1 s. The shortest recastable ability is Q at 7 s, and Q is explicitly affectedByCdr:false in the cache (only R's passive 10/20/30 ability haste touches it): 7*100/(100+30) = 5.38 s at R rank 3, 7*100/(100+50) = 4.67 s. No ability's cooldown can elapse inside the first ~1 s, so no repeat cast can be interposed ahead of R under the greedy shared-timeline rule.
candidate_C_R_as_the_single_cast_schedul.verdict_for_this_leaf: a 5th-position R would require the scheduler to idle R for ~5 s while it was off cooldown -- contradicting the documented greedy 'recast when off cooldown and no other cast is in progress' semantics

independent_computation.step_3_what_the_order_should_be: Both fight modes agree that index 4 must be absent-or-not-R: (a) one_rotation -> exactly one cast per castable ability = 4 entries [Q, W, E, R] in some derivation-dependent permutation, so index 4 does not exist; (b) a timed window -> the first four entries are the four abilities cast greedily at t~0, and the earliest possible 5th entry is a repeat of Q (5.38 s at R rank 3, sooner with items) or W (8-12 s base, CDR-affected), never R. In neither reading does 'R' belong at index 4.
independent_computation.step_4_conclusion: The retirement of cast_order[4] is consistent with the sources: Syndra's derived rotation is a four-cast list. The one invariant that must survive the change is that R still appears exactly once (at index 3 under the four-cast reading); the documented 'R single-cast' rule is satisfied by a single R inside a 4-entry order and violated only if R disappeared from the list entirely.
independent_computation.residual_uncertainty: The oracle tree contains no scenario definition for 'syndra_derived_order_39' (grep for 'syndra_derived_order' / 'coupled_scenarios' across data/ and docs/math-foundations.md returns nothing), so the scenario's level, ranks, splinters option and fight window could not be read. The verdict rests on the invariants above, which hold for every level/rank/option combination Syndra admits. It would flip to 'both_wrong' only if the new 4-entry order contains no 'R' at all, which no sourced rule supports.
